# PlayGrid Payment & Checkout Gateway (llms.txt)

> PlayGrid Payment is the secure checkout gateway supporting VietQR automated payment processing, promotional vouchers, and corporate VAT invoice issuance.

- [Court Checkout](https://payment.playgrid.vn/vi/checkout/court): Court Booking Checkout
- [Event Checkout](https://payment.playgrid.vn/vi/checkout/event): Tournament & Ticket Checkout
- [Terms](https://playgrid.vn/vi/terms): Payment Terms & Refund Policy
- [Main Portal](https://playgrid.vn): PlayGrid Web
